---
output: html_document
params:
  revision: null
  logo: ""
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 5.8, fig.height = 3.0, dpi = 120)
r = params$revision
compact = identical(r$type, "ESSENTIEL")
identite = eduschool::identite_revision(r)
```

```{r entete, results='asis'}
if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  cat(eduschool:::.css_fiche_eduschool(), "\n")
  cat(eduschool:::.bandeau_revision_html(r, params$logo), "\n")
} else {
  cat("\\noindent\\begin{minipage}[t]{0.72\\textwidth}\n")
  cat("\\textbf{", identite$cycle, " -- ", identite$classe, "}\\\\\n", sep = "")
  cat("{\\Large\\textbf{", identite$matiere, "}}\\\\[0.35em]\n", sep = "")
  cat("\\textsc{", identite$type, "}\\\\\n", sep = "")
  cat(identite$titre, "\n")
  cat("\\end{minipage}\\hfill\\begin{minipage}[t]{0.23\\textwidth}\\raggedleft\n")
  if (nzchar(params$logo) && file.exists(params$logo)) {
    cat("\\includegraphics[width=2.8cm]{\\detokenize{", normalizePath(params$logo, winslash = "/"), "}}\n", sep = "")
  }
  cat("\\end{minipage}\\par\\vspace{0.7em}\\hrule\\vspace{1em}\n")
}
```

`r r$description`

```{r blocs, results='asis'}
for (i in seq_len(nrow(r$blocs))) {
  b = r$blocs[i, ]
  if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
    cat('<div class="eduschool-bloc" style="--edu-accent:', identite$couleur, '">\n', sep = "")
  }
  cat("\n## ", b$titre, "\n\n", sep = "")
  if (nzchar(b$contenu)) cat(b$contenu, "\n\n")
  if (nzchar(b$formule)) cat("$$", b$formule, "$$\n\n")
  if (nzchar(b$illustration_id)) {
    eduschool:::.dessiner_revision(b$illustration_id)
    cat("\n")
  }
  if (knitr::is_html_output()) cat("</div>\n")
}
```

```{r notions, results='asis'}
if (!compact && nrow(r$notions)) {
  cat("\n## Notions eduschool reliees\n\n")
  for (x in unique(r$notions$libelle)) if (!is.na(x) && nzchar(x)) cat("- ", x, "\n", sep = "")
}
```
